lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: I keep the gate of ruin. Every stone remembers the name of a man who thought himself worthy.

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: Let the foundations answer!

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: Your courage breaks before my blade.

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: Even ruin... must end.

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: They buried my rebellion beneath their holy stones. Now I am the ground beneath your feet.

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: Listen. The earth is opening.

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: No throne stands above the grave!

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: At last... silence below.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: From these heights I saw their prayers become commands. Why climb, little pilgrim? The sky has no mercy.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: You cannot outrun a falling star.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: Look up. Your judgment descends.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: So this... is falling.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: Welcome to my golden table. Lay down your will, and I shall call it devotion.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: Kneel before perfection.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: Every jewel demands its offering.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: Gold... cannot mend this.

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: Below us, famine teaches men to kneel. Here I have built a language every tongue understands: obedience.

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: The princess is the promise that binds them. You would tear down my heaven for one life? Then I shall bury you beneath it.

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: I am the crown of this tower!

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: Let every stone bear witness to your failure!

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: No! I will not be scattered, forgotten among the nameless. If heaven will not have me, heaven will burn!

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: My name... they will remember... my name.

lines.speaker: The Pilgrim
lines.text: I have not come for your throne. Let me pass.

lines.speaker: The Pilgrim
lines.text: A prison does not become heaven because you build it high. Release Livia.

lines.speaker: The Wayfarer
lines.text: Bread for the road, light for the dark. Even Babel has room for an honest bargain. [E] Trade

lines.speaker: The Wayfarer
lines.text: Keep your blade keen and your soul your own. The tower has taken enough. [E] Trade

lines.speaker: The Wayfarer
lines.text: The higher the throne, the longer its shadow. Take what you need, pilgrim. [E] Trade

lines.speaker: The Western Gate
lines.text: Nero's seal is broken. Beyond the western passage, daylight waits.

lines.speaker: Livia
lines.text: Here! Beyond the tower. I knew you would find the road.

lines.speaker: Livia
lines.text: For so long I could hear only the bells. Now I can hear the sea.

lines.speaker: The Pilgrim
lines.text: Nero is gone. The western gate is open. You are free, Livia.

lines.speaker: Livia
lines.text: He promised to raise us above suffering. All he did was place more stone between us.

lines.speaker: The Pilgrim
lines.text: Then let us leave the stones behind. Messina still needs its people.

lines.speaker: Livia
lines.text: And we shall return together. Not as his promise. As ourselves.

lines.speaker: Dawn beyond Babel
lines.text: The princess was rescued. Beneath a sky no tyrant could possess, two travelers took the road home.

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: Break beneath the gate!

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: Stone outlasts flesh.

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: That blade is a prayer. I have heard better.

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: You stumble like the men who built these walls.

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: Another step? Have you so little to live for?

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: There is room in the foundations for one more.

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: Your footing belongs to me!

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: Down, where the faithful left me!

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: Hear that hollow sound? Your courage, I think.

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: They called me faithless. What will they call you?

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: Keep running. Every road ends in earth.

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: I waited centuries. You will not last a minute.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: Fall with your foolish hopes!

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: The air itself condemns you.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: Still looking for a stairway to heaven?

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: Your little jumps are almost charming.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: The sky has room for wings. None for your pride.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: Climb higher. It makes the fall worth watching.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: Let crystal carve your tribute!

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: Shatter, little offering!

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: All that effort, and still so poorly dressed.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: Is that your finest blade? How unfortunate.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: I collect beautiful things. You will be an exception.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: Come now. Even your fear lacks elegance.

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: Bow, or be broken!

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: My will is law!

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: Did they send a hero, or simply their last fool?

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: You call this courage? I call it a brief mistake.

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: I built a heaven. You cannot even hold your ground.

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: When you fall, I shall have your name scraped from the stone.

lines.speaker: Abaddon
lines.text: The builders heard a warning and asked for higher walls. I taught them to fear the voice that shook the stone. Will you listen, Hollow?

lines.speaker: Korah
lines.text: They made this court a market for forgiveness. I overturned their tables; Nero buried me with the debtors. Now every trespasser pays in blood.

lines.speaker: Azazel
lines.text: They called the meek blessed. From my pulpit, I watched them starve. Climb, pilgrim. Show me a mercy that can rise above my judgment.

lines.speaker: Bel
lines.text: One final supper, and not a crust for those below. Livia refused my cup. Will you also choose the hungry over a place beside the crown?

lines.speaker: Nero
lines.text: I prayed while my people died. Heaven answered nothing. Must she suffer for them too? No. Livia will remain my promise, and you will be my sacrifice.

lines.speaker: Livia
lines.text: You entered looking for shelter. Still, you came for me. Let us build nothing that asks another person to suffer in our place.
